title: Schedule a meeting
structure:
The .topbar has

Schedule a meeting

and a .top-right with one .btn-primary-sm containing a calendar svg and span "Schedule meeting". The .content block itself carries inline style "display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.3fr 1fr;gap:18px;" and holds exactly two .form-panel children (white, navy-100 border, radius 16, padding 22). LEFT PANEL (1.3fr), in order: 1) .seg (navy-100 tray, radius 11, padding 4, margin-bottom 16) with four .seg-item: "AGM" (.active, navy-600 fill white text), "EGM", "Committee", "Phase meeting". 2) .m-field → label "Meeting title" + .m-input.focused (white, amber border, amber glow) with span "Annual General Meeting 2026". 3) .m-two-col holding two .m-field: label "Date" + .m-input span "Saturday, 27 Sep 2026"; label "Time" + .m-input span "10:00 AM". 4) .m-field → label "Audience" + .m-input span "Whole estate — all 5 phases". 5) .m-two-col holding two .m-field: label "Quorum threshold" + .m-input span "25% of eligible households"; label "Recording" + .m-input span "Enabled, with consent notice". 6) .m-field → label "Agenda" followed by four .agenda-item rows, each .ai-time + .ai-txt + .ai-remove (white 24px square holding an X svg): "10:00" / "Welcome & confirmation of quorum"; "10:15" / "Treasurer's report — FY2025/26"; "10:45" / "Security update from Gemini Security Ltd"; "11:15" / "Motion: approve 2026/27 budget". Then .add-agenda (plus svg + span) "Add agenda item". RIGHT PANEL (1fr), in order: an unclassed heading div (Poppins 13.5px, weight 600, margin-bottom 14) "Preview"; then a gradient preview card
containing an amber 10px eyebrow "ANNUAL GENERAL MEETING", a Poppins 15px title "Phoenix Park Village 1 — AGM 2026", and an 11px translucent line "Saturday 27 September · 10:00 AM · Whole estate"; then a helper paragraph (11.5px slate-500, line-height 1.6): "Residents will see this on their Notices feed and in Meetings once scheduled. Only verified households in the selected audience can join — there's no shareable link."
accounting_notes: No figures are posted on this screen, but two agenda lines bind the meeting to accounting periods and must resolve to real records: "Treasurer's report — FY2025/26" (a fiscal year label, so the meeting/agenda item needs a fiscal_year reference, financial year running 2025/26) and "Motion: approve 2026/27 budget" (a motion tied to the NEXT fiscal year's budget record, 2026/27). The quorum threshold "25% of eligible households" is the governance threshold that would validate any budget-approval motion carried at this meeting.
domain_needs: meeting.type ∈ AGM | EGM | Committee | Phase meeting (segmented control, AGM selected by default); meeting.type_label uppercase form "ANNUAL GENERAL MEETING" used in the preview eyebrow (DERIVED from type)
meeting.date = "Saturday, 27 Sep 2026" (stored as a date; long display format "EEEE, d MMM yyyy" in the form and "EEEE d MMMM" without year in the preview line "Saturday 27 September")
meeting.audience = "Whole estate — all 5 phases"; needs audience_scope ∈ whole_estate | phase_subset plus the phase count 5 (DERIVED from estate.phase_count)

meeting.quorum_threshold_percent = 25, rendered "25% of eligible households" (basis = eligible households, the same 450 denominator used on screens 09 and 11; quorum head-count would be DERIVED as 25% of 450 = 113 households)
meeting.recording_enabled = true and meeting.recording_consent_notice = true, rendered as one combined value "Enabled, with consent notice"

meeting_agenda_item.start_time — "10:00", "10:15", "10:45", "11:15" (24-hour HH:mm in the agenda list, unlike the 12-hour Time field); implies each item's duration is DERIVED from the next item's start (15, 30, 30 minutes)
meeting_agenda_item.text — "Welcome & confirmation of quorum", "Treasurer's report — FY2025/26", "Security update from Gemini Security Ltd", "Motion: approve 2026/27 budget"
meeting_agenda_item.sort_order — 1..4, ascending by start_time; items are removable (X) and appendable ("Add agenda item")
meeting_agenda_item may reference a fiscal year (FY2025/26) or a motion/budget record (2026/27 budget)
vendor/company name "Gemini Security Ltd" referenced in an agenda item (security provider entity)
community.name = "Phoenix Park Village 1" and preview title "Phoenix Park Village 1 — AGM 2026" (DERIVED: community name + short meeting type + year)
preview summary line "Saturday 27 September · 10:00 AM · Whole estate" (DERIVED from date, time and audience, joined with middot separators)

publication rule copy: meetings appear on the resident Notices feed and in Meetings once scheduled; access limited to verified households in the selected audience, no shareable link — implies meeting.visibility is audience-scoped and household verification status gates attendance
meeting.status transitions on the "Schedule meeting" action (draft → scheduled)
